text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long this chronic wound on your right lower leg has been present and what activities or injuries preceded it?

speaker: Patient
text: 57-year-old male. The patient reports a large wound on his right lower leg that has been present for 6 months. He mentions that his legs have been chronically swollen for over 10 years and that his mother and brother had similar leg problems. He had a documented deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in the affected leg 5 years ago but has no other significant past medical history.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency with associated stasis ulceration.

Thank you for that detailed history; the 10-year history of bilateral leg swelling combined with your family history strongly points to a venous issue rather than arterial disease. Given your past DVT, I want to confirm the current status of your venous system and check for any active infection. REQUEST TEST: Venous_Doppler_Ultrasound.
